source_policy: Prefer the official Digimon Encyclopedia (Bandai, with Toei copyright) and Toei Adventure character pages. Attack mechanics are paraphrased; local combat effects must be labeled as game interpretation.

attacks.name: Pepper Breath
attacks.mechanism: Spits a small ball of flame at the opponent.

attacks.name: Spiral Twister
attacks.mechanism: Attacks with spectral flames.

attacks.name: Super Shocker
attacks.mechanism: Releases an electrical shock from its body.

attacks.name: Poison Ivy
attacks.mechanism: Extends poisonous vines to ensnare and strike a target.

attacks.name: Marching Fishes
attacks.mechanism: Commands a squad of small fish to attack.

attacks.name: Air Shot
attacks.mechanism: Takes a deep breath and releases a powerful blast of air.

attacks.name: Wing Slap
attacks.mechanism: Strikes the opponent with its large ears.

attacks.name: Lightning Paw
attacks.mechanism: Strikes with its claws.

attacks.name: Cat's Eye
attacks.mechanism: Uses a piercing gaze to manipulate the target into attacking itself.

attacks.name: Mega Flame
attacks.mechanism: Breathes superheated flame from its mouth.

attacks.name: Giga Destroyer
attacks.mechanism: Fires organic missiles from the hatch in its chest.

attacks.name: Gaia Force
attacks.mechanism: Concentrates energy from the atmosphere into a super-dense, high-temperature energy sphere and fires it.

attacks.name: Brave Tornado
attacks.mechanism: Joins the Dramon Killers overhead, spins rapidly, then charges through the target.

attacks.name: Fox Fire
attacks.mechanism: Breathes an intense stream of blue flame.

attacks.name: Kaiser Nail
attacks.mechanism: Slashes the opponent with the sharp claws on both arms.

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.mechanism: Breathes absolute-zero air that freezes what it touches.

attacks.name: Garuru Tomahawk
attacks.mechanism: Fires the large Freeze Bomber missile from its chest.

attacks.name: Ice Wolf Claw
attacks.mechanism: Fires all the weapons on its body at once.

attacks.name: Meteor Wing
attacks.mechanism: Fires flaming feathers toward its opponent.

attacks.name: Shadow Wing
attacks.mechanism: Fires a high-speed wind blade that is too fast to see; only its bird-shaped shadow is visible.

attacks.name: Starlight Explosion
attacks.mechanism: Flaps its four sacred wings to rain golden light particles that cleanse evil.

attacks.name: Horn Buster
attacks.mechanism: Stabs the opponent with its giant horn. This profile is the red Vaccine variant.

attacks.name: Giga Blaster
attacks.mechanism: An upgraded Mega Blaster; Toei describes the attack as obliterating targets it hits.

attacks.name: Needle Spray
attacks.mechanism: Hardens the needles on its fists and unleashes a flurry of punches.

attacks.name: Flower Cannon
attacks.mechanism: Extends both arms, turns the wrist flowers into cannon mouths, and fires an energy bomb.

attacks.name: Thorn Whip
attacks.mechanism: Lashes with an electrically charged thorn whip that can captivate its target.

attacks.name: Roses Rapier
attacks.mechanism: Uses the sharp end of its whip to finish the opponent.

attacks.name: Forbidden Temptation
attacks.mechanism: Surrounds the target with rose blossoms that destroy its data.

attacks.name: Harpoon Torpedo
attacks.mechanism: Fires the horn on its head at the opponent; the horn can regrow.

attacks.name: Vulcan's Hammer
attacks.mechanism: Slams Thor's Hammer down, creating a powerful shockwave and flying sparks.

attacks.name: Arctic Blizzard
attacks.mechanism: Lowers the surrounding temperature to absolute zero, then shatters the frozen target with Mjölnir.

attacks.name: Heaven's Knuckle
attacks.mechanism: Pummels its opponent with shining golden fists.

attacks.name: Heaven's Gate
attacks.mechanism: Opens a one-way door to subspace and sends its opponent through it.

attacks.name: Seven Heavens
attacks.mechanism: Fires seven superheated spheres of light at the opponent.

attacks.name: Testament
attacks.mechanism: Creates a Big Bang at the cost of its own life.

attacks.name: Celestial Arrow
attacks.mechanism: Fires a powerful lightning attack.

attacks.name: Heaven's Charm
attacks.mechanism: Fires a beam of beauty and kindness that is more effective against stronger dark power.

attacks.name: Holy Flame
attacks.mechanism: Projects the energy of righteous light at its opponent.

attacks.name: Transcendent Sword
attacks.mechanism: Uses the blade on its WarGreymon-shaped left arm to slash its target.

attacks.name: Supreme Cannon
attacks.mechanism: Fires absolute-zero air from its MetalGarurumon-shaped right arm to freeze its target.
